newsitem.title: USA: Xavier responds to Morgan Grenfell reports.
newsitem.headline: Xavier responds to Morgan Grenfell reports.

text.p: Xavier Corp responded Friday to news stories in the European press concerning reviews by British regulatory authorities of two investment funds managed by Morgan Grenfell Asset Management. MGAM is an institutional shareholder of Xavier Corp.
One of the securities mentioned in news reports is the warrants issued to Russ Oil and Technology SA to purchase shares of Xavier.

Xavier said in a statement that details of the issue of the Russ Oil warrants -- issued by Xavier in connection with its issuance of an unsecured promissory note to D. Carnegie AB -- were fully disclosed in its Form S-4 registration statement filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in May.
Xavier said its outside board members have initiated a due diligence review of the facts, as a precaution.
